title: Nelson Richardson gaming modpack
description: A Fabric modpack with all the mods I use.
body: This is the Nelson Richardson Gaming Modpack, created off‑camera as a fun mix of performance, quality‑of‑life, and gameplay mods. It’s designed to make Minecraft smoother, more exciting, and more enjoyable without changing the core feel of the game. This pack is separate from the modpack I use in my videos. Shader used: Complementary Reimagined — https://www.complementary.dev/
